node.label: Abnormality of the axillary hair
node.definition: Abnormality of the growth of the axillary hair. Axillary hair is part of the secondary sexual hair, which normally ensues during puberty.

evidence.snippet: Addison disease: Abnormality of the axillary hair (frequency HP:0040282) [TAS]
Abnormality of the axillary hair — Frequent (79-30%)
